left.raw_text: Aged 5 years to less than 12 years at Visit 1.
At least 15 (25%) children of the total study population must be aged 5 to less than 8 years.
Subjects must be pre-adolescent without any signs of puberty (Tanner Stage 1).
Normal range for their height and weight.
Weight and height measurements should fall within the percentile range 3-97% of normal values for age according to Danish growth charts.
